content: As of 2024, the **tallest building in the world** is the **Burj Khalifa** in **Dubai, United Arab Emirates**. It stands at a height of **828 meters** (2,717 feet) and has 163 floors above ground. The Burj Khalifa has held the title of the world's tallest building since its completion in 2010.
